independent_probe_script:
extends SceneTree
const Config=preload("res://scripts/data/board_trial_config.gd")
class HeldTrial extends "res://scripts/audio_trial.gd":
	func _brain(_actor: Dictionary, _delta: float) -> void: pass
var failures:=0
var assertions:=0
var cases:=[]
var output:="/tmp/qa07-audio-trial-20261011/probes-source.json"
func _initialize(): call_deferred("run")
func check(ok: bool,label: String):
	assertions+=1
	if not ok:
		failures+=1
		push_error(label)
func fresh():
	var g=HeldTrial.new()
	root.add_child(g)
	g.set_process(false)
	return g
func role(g,key: String):
	return g.actors.filter(func(a): return a.key==key)[0]
func advance(g,seconds: float):
	for i in int(ceil(seconds/Config.STEP)): g.step(Config.STEP)
func crowded_setup():
	var scene=load("res://scenes/audio_trial.tscn").instantiate()
	root.add_child(scene)
	scene.set_process(false)
	check(scene.setup_specs.size()==2 and scene.actors[0].key=="guard_monk","actual scene initializes default")
	scene.free()
	var g=fresh()
	g.clear_trial()
	check(not g.start_battle() and not g.ui.status_label.text.is_empty(),"empty setup gives actual UI feedback")
	check(g.add_units(true,"guard_monk",6) and g.add_units(false,"wolf",6),"maximum duplicate setup")
	var before=g.setup_specs.duplicate(true)
	check(not g.add_units(false,"wolf",1) and g.setup_specs==before and not g.ui.status_label.text.is_empty(),"overflow atomic with actual feedback")
	var ids={}
	for a in g.actors:
		check(not ids.has(a.id),"12 unique IDs")
		ids[a.id]=true
	var a=g.actors[0]
	var b=g.actors[1]
	var foe=g.actors[6]
	var original=a.cell
	g.select(a.id)
	g._place_from_input(b.cell)
	check(b.cell==original and g.selected.is_empty(),"same team input swap releases selection")
	g.select(a.id)
	before=g.setup_specs.duplicate(true)
	g._place_from_input(foe.cell)
	check(g.setup_specs==before and g.selected==a.id,"cross army input reject retains selection and all specs")
	var moved:=0
	for y in Config.ROWS:
		for x in Config.COLS:
			var c=Vector2i(x,y)
			if g._occupant(c,a.id).is_empty():
				check(g.place(a.id,c),"full board placement")
				moved+=1
	check(moved>60,"full board legal empty cells exercised")
	g.start_battle()
	g.toggle_pause()
	before=g.setup_specs.duplicate(true)
	g.select(a.id)
	g._place_from_input(Vector2i(0,0))
	check(g.setup_specs==before and not g.remove_selected(),"paused input cannot edit roster")
	cases.append({"case":"actual_scene_and_max_duplicate_input","instances":ids.size(),"legal_empty_cell_moves":moved})
	g.free()
func filter_events():
	var g=fresh()
	var monk=role(g,"guard_monk")
	var wolf=role(g,"wolf")
	g.place(wolf.id,Vector2i(5,3))
	g.start_battle()
	var events=[]
	g.combat.resolved.connect(func(_t,_a,_h,e): events.append(e.duplicate(false)))
	g._attack(monk,wolf)
	advance(g,0.8)
	check(g.metrics.damage.get(monk.id,0)==monk.damage and g.audio_feedback.stats.played==1,"real first monk hit schedules once")
	var slots=g.audio_feedback.primary_slots.duplicate(true)
	g.set_listen(false,false)
	check(g.audio_feedback.primary_slots==slots,"filter toggles do not clear or change old voice reservation tails")
	g._attack(wolf,monk)
	advance(g,0.8)
	check(events.size()==2 and g.audio_feedback.filtered_count==1 and g.audio_feedback.stats.played==1,"new opposing actual hit consumed while filtered")
	g.set_listen(true,true)
	if events.size()==2: g.audio_feedback.role_applied(events[1],wolf.damage)
	check(g.audio_feedback.stats.duplicates==1 and g.audio_feedback.stats.played==1,"old filtered serial never catches up after reopen")
	wolf.cooldown=0 # Isolate next real event; not a natural attack-rate test.
	g._attack(wolf,monk)
	advance(g,0.8)
	check(events.size()==3 and g.audio_feedback.stats.played==2 and g.audio_feedback.seen.size()==3,"fresh serial resumes after reopen")
	cases.append({"case":"dynamic_filter_true_events_and_tail_reservations","actual_events":events.size(),"stats":g.audio_feedback.stats.duplicate(true),"filtered":g.audio_feedback.filtered_count})
	g.free()
func pending_retry():
	var g=fresh()
	g.clear_trial()
	g.add_units(true,"wild_hunter",1)
	g.add_units(true,"guard_monk",1)
	g.add_units(false,"wolf",1)
	var hunter=role(g,"wild_hunter")
	var monk=role(g,"guard_monk")
	var wolf=role(g,"wolf")
	g.place(hunter.id,Vector2i(3,3))
	g.place(wolf.id,Vector2i(6,3))
	g.start_battle()
	var start=g.start_specs.duplicate(true)
	var old_nodes=[]
	for a in g.actors: old_nodes.append(a.node)
	g._attack(hunter,wolf)
	for i in 120:
		g.step(Config.STEP)
		if not g.combat.missiles.is_empty(): break
	check(g.combat.missiles.size()==1 and g.audio_feedback.seen.size()==1,"real pending arrow and audio history exist before retry")
	monk.node.take_damage(monk.hp_max)
	g.step(Config.STEP)
	check(monk.dead and g.combat.missiles.size()==1,"actual friend death coexists with pending arrow")
	g.audio_feedback.level=0.35
	g.audio_feedback.enabled=false
	g.set_listen(false,true)
	g.toggle_pause()
	g.retry()
	check(g.phase==g.Phase.BATTLE and not g.paused and g.elapsed==0 and g.setup_specs==start,"retry exact snapshot and immediately unpaused")
	for n in old_nodes: check(not is_instance_valid(n),"old node freed by retry")
	check(g.combat.missiles.is_empty() and g.combat.strikes.is_empty() and g.combat.marks.is_empty() and g.audio_feedback.seen.is_empty() and g.audio_feedback.audit.is_empty(),"pending/death/audio residue cleared")
	for a in g.actors:
		check(not a.dead and a.node.health==a.hp_max and g._occupant(a.cell).id==a.id and a.move.is_empty(),"fresh full HP and unique occupancy")
	advance(g,0.6)
	check(g.metrics.damage.is_empty(),"discarded old arrow never damages rebuilt lineup")
	check(g.audio_feedback.level==0.35 and not g.audio_feedback.enabled and not g.listen_friendly and g.listen_enemy,"sound controls retained")
	g.return_to_setup()
	check(g.phase==g.Phase.DEPLOY and g.setup_specs==start,"return original deployment after new run")
	cases.append({"case":"true_pending_arrow_death_pause_retry_return","old_nodes_freed":old_nodes.size(),"discarded_pending_missiles":1})
	g.free()
func healing():
	var g=fresh()
	g.healing_preset()
	var monk=role(g,"guard_monk")
	var healer=role(g,"herbal_spirit_child")
	g.set_initial_health(monk.id,1.0)
	g.start_battle()
	check(g._healing_target(healer).is_empty(),"full roster not a healing target")
	# Deliberately force two real requests to inspect zero/effective HP boundaries.
	g.combat.request(healer.node,monk.node,true,false)
	advance(g,0.8)
	check(g.combat.counts.heals==1 and g.metrics.healing.get(healer.id,0)==0 and g.audio_feedback.stats.requested==0,"full HP actual heal event produces no sound")
	monk.node.take_damage(1)
	g.combat.request(healer.node,monk.node,true,false)
	advance(g,0.8)
	check(g.combat.counts.heals==2 and g.metrics.healing.get(healer.id,0)==1 and monk.node.health==monk.hp_max and g.audio_feedback.stats.played==1,"exact one effective HP restored with one healing cue")
	cases.append({"case":"full_and_one_HP_true_heal","resolved_heals":g.combat.counts.heals,"effective_HP":g.metrics.healing.get(healer.id,0),"audio_requests":g.audio_feedback.stats.requested})
	g.free()
func optional_core():
	var g=fresh()
	g.add_units(true,"tangseng",1)
	g.start_battle()
	var core=role(g,"tangseng")
	core.node.take_damage(core.hp_max)
	g.step(Config.STEP)
	check(core.dead and g.phase==g.Phase.BATTLE and g.result_count==0,"core death alone does not end trial")
	for a in g.actors:
		if g._active(a): a.node.take_damage(a.hp_max)
	g.step(Config.STEP)
	check(g.phase==g.Phase.RESULT and not g.victory and g.result_count==1 and g.audio_feedback.rejected_keys.is_empty(),"last armies simultaneous death uses failure without disabled cue")
	cases.append({"case":"optional_core_death_then_simultaneous_all","result_count":g.result_count,"victory":g.victory})
	g.free()
func run():
	for arg in OS.get_cmdline_user_args():
		if arg.begins_with("--output="): output=arg.trim_prefix("--output=")
	crowded_setup()
	filter_events()
	pending_retry()
	healing()
	optional_core()
	check(cases.size()==5,"all five independent groups completed")
	var f=FileAccess.open(output,FileAccess.WRITE)
	f.store_string(JSON.stringify({"groups":cases,"group_count":cases.size(),"assertions":assertions,"failures":failures,"held_AI_is_boundary_fixture_not_natural":true},"\t"))
	print("QA07_TRIAL groups=",cases.size()," assertions=",assertions," failures=",failures)
	quit(1 if failures else 0)
